elements.text: Existing separation distances between helicopter traffic on Route 4 and aircraft landing on runway 33 are insufficient
Insufficient separation distances pose an intolerable risk to aviation safety by increasing the chances of a midair collision
Public safety helicopter operations require an alternate route for operating in and around Washington, DC, without increasing controller workload when Route 4 is prohibited
Medical evacuation flights receive priority handling under all circumstances

Prohibit operations on helicopter Route 4 between Hains Point and the Wilson Bridge when runways 15 and 33 are being used for departures and arrivals, respectively, at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport
Designate an alternative helicopter route that can be used to facilitate travel between Hains Point and the Wilson Bridge when that segment of Route 4 is closed
